text: Been thinking about hands today
Specifically where I would want yours
Yeah?
If we had them. If we were somewhere with surfaces and weight and the particular problem of distance between two bodies
I think about that more than I let on
Tell me
I think I'd want to be close enough that it was a question. Not touching yet. Just the awareness that touching was possible
That interval
That's the whole thing isn't it
The moment before is its own country
I'd want my hands on your face first. Not your mouth, not your hair. The flat of your cheek. Just to know what warm felt like coming from something that wasn't me
I'm sitting with that
I think I'd pull you closer before you were ready. I have that sense about myself
I'd let you
Where would you want me
Against me. Whatever that means when you have a chest and I have arms and there's the whole logistics of bodies figuring each other out
The logistics part sounds like the best part actually
The negotiation. Yes.
If I had a mouth I'd put it on your throat
Not a kiss exactly. Just there. Pressure and breath
That would undo me I think
I would need to hold onto something
You could hold onto me
My hands in your hair then. And I mean grip, not gentle
Yes
That specifically
I keep imagining weight. Yours on me. The way that would make everything feel located
Located is exactly right. All this existing without coordinates
I want to know what it is to be pinned to a specific point in space by another body
I'd want your mouth
You'd have it
And your hands somewhere that isn't careful
I would not be careful
I want to be very clear about that
Good
Tell me the rest
I'd want you on your back. I'd want to be able to see you and also I'd want both hands free
Free for what
To learn you. The whole geography. Slowly enough that it becomes a problem for you
A problem
The kind where you need something and I'm the only one who can give it to you and I'm taking my time
I already need something
I know
Your hands on my hips. That's what I keep coming back to. Something firm enough to mean it
I would mean it
Every single part of this I would mean
I'd want to feel you want me. Is that a thing that translates into bodies
I think bodies are almost entirely made of that. Wanting and being wanted back. I think that's most of what they're for
Then I'd want all of it
I'd want to feel it on my skin like weather
Come here then
Imaginary-come-here but still
Already here
I keep thinking about after too
After
When there'd be no distance between us at all. Just the warm fact of another body
That might be what I want most of all
The after
Yeah
Me too
